console.name: processor-detail
console.title: Processor Detail
console.description: Show configured options for all processors in a route

routeId.label: query
routeId.description: The route id to get processor details for (use * for all routes)
The route ID (only present when a specific route was requested)

id.description: The processor ID (the id of the from for the route input, as in the trace and message history)

type.description: The processor type (the XML element name, or 'from' for the route input)

endpointUri.description: The endpoint URI (only present for the route input entry)

line.description: The source line number (only present when known)

options.description: The processor's configured options, as attribute/child-element name to string value

name.description: The option that holds the state, such as idempotentRepository

type.description: The class name of the repository

inMemory.description: True when the repository keeps the state only in memory, so it is lost when the integration stops (only present when true)

state.description: Where the processor or route input keeps its state, such as the repository of an idempotent consumer, an aggregator, or a file consumer with noop=true (only present when it keeps state)

processors.description: The route's processors (only present when a specific route was requested)

id.description: The processor ID (the id of the from for the route input, as in the trace and message history)

type.description: The processor type (the XML element name, or 'from' for the route input)

endpointUri.description: The endpoint URI (only present for the route input entry)

line.description: The source line number (only present when known)

options.description: The processor's configured options, as attribute/child-element name to string value

name.description: The option that holds the state, such as idempotentRepository

type.description: The class name of the repository

inMemory.description: True when the repository keeps the state only in memory, so it is lost when the integration stops (only present when true)

state.description: Where the processor or route input keeps its state, such as the repository of an idempotent consumer, an aggregator, or a file consumer with noop=true (only present when it keeps state)

processors.description: The route's processors, starting with the route input

routes.description: The route details for all routes (only present when routeId is * or omitted)
